title.label: Money trap… took my money and ran…

content.label:
EDIT: I was able to reach out to the support team on their Telegram channel. They are nice and are working on fixing my account and refunding the money I lost. Will post an updated review if it all goes well and will add more stars.

First off, not everything about this app is negative. Honestly, the app seems to work good and I like the fact that there is a community aspect for accountability and such. Unfortunately, there have been a couple bugs where every time that the app would update, it would log me out so when I logged back in to check my progress, I would have to sign in again, and my current subscription would have lapsed. It would then prompt me to pay for a new subscription where I would then click “Restore Purchase”.
Unfortunately, it looks like every time that would happen, I would be billed for an entirely new subscription. First, it was some yearly subscriptions, but then I was billed for two different lifetime subscriptions! Seriously? That’s over $150 for one app when I should have a lifetime subscription where I should never have to pay for it again. I have reached out to the support team twice now and I’ve not heard anything back.

Hopefully, I can come back and change my review to four or five stars if the support team will get back to me and will do right by me by at least partially refunding so much of the money I have invested in this app. 

Otherwise, if I don’t hear anything back, I would encourage everyone to stay away from this app. There are other programs out there that are not as expensive with a more active and more easily reachable support team.
The fact that there is not a phone number to reach out to someone with this app is a pretty big red flag.

1. I bought the yearly plan for $21.64 to access the app.

2. Once inside, I saw the Lifetime Deal for $54.11 and upgraded, assuming the first payment would be refunded since I now chose lifetime access. Both purchases were made within the same 10 minutes.

3. Two days later, the first payment was still not refunded. I emailed support four times with no response. I then contacted Apple to see if it could be refunded, explained the situation, and they refunded only the $21.64.

4.	They denied the refund for the Lifetime Plan, even though I only requested for the first plan so I could keep the app, and said the decision was final.

5. The next day, I opened the app and discovered I had lost all access—despite the fact that the $54.11 Lifetime Plan was NEVER refunded. They kept my money and removed my account.

Do not buy from them. They WILL take advantage of you when they can.
